tools.desc: Sign, fill in, annotate, highlight, redact and edit text in a PDF. Private: it never leaves your browser.

tools.title: Ground Rod & Earthing Simulator
tools.desc: Find a ground rod's resistance for your soil, see why a rod doesn't trip a breaker, model lightning step voltage and static discharge, and read the grounding rules for your region.

tools.title: Julia Set Explorer
tools.desc: Drag a point on a map of the Mandelbrot set and watch its Julia set change live. Walk c around the cardioid, zoom and save pictures.

tools.title: Archive
tools.desc: Save or find any web page on the Wayback Machine, archive.today, Ghostarchive and more at once. Includes a one-click browser extension.

tools.title: Domain Lookup
tools.desc: Whois for the web: domain age, registrar, expiry, who hosts a site, DNS and email setup, and warning signs.

tools.title: EXIF Viewer
tools.desc: See the camera, date, GPS location and AI / edit flags hidden in a photo, and save a copy with the metadata removed.

tools.title: Reverse Image Search
tools.desc: Paste an image link or upload a picture and search Google Lens, Bing, TinEye, Yandex and more at once. Search part of the picture.

tools.title: Buddhabrot Explorer
tools.desc: Watch the Buddhabrot fill in live: millions of random Mandelbrot orbits piled into a glowing figure. Try the three-colour Nebulabrot and the Anti-Buddhabrot.

tools.title: Electromagnetic Fields Simulator
tools.desc: Place charges and wires and see field lines, Gauss's law and Ampère's law, steer a particle through E and B fields, and watch Maxwell's equations make waves reflect, refract and diffract.

tools.title: Double Pendulum
tools.desc: Drag two swinging arms into place and watch chaos: a fan of copies that drift apart, how fast errors grow, and a fractal map of how long each start takes to flip.

tools.title: Orbit Simulator
tools.desc: Launch planets by dragging, watch real gravity with many bodies, see Kepler's laws and equal areas, try Halley's comet, the Moon and a gravity assist, and compute orbit speeds and transfers.
